what: Items scattered large and small around the section, each floating (rising 16px with a 4° tilt on a 3~4s cycle), fly to the i-th cell of the slot row in order of center x once the section is half in view, shrinking to cell size and settling (1.1s cubic-bezier(.3,.9,.3,1.06) with a slight overshoot, each cell 70ms later). After settling, from 1.6s on and every 2.8s they squash in turn (.12s apart) and hop up 22%. When the section drops 12% below the viewport they scatter back to their places over .8s

options.[data-fx-part=flier]: Items that fly in (children) — style’s --x·--y (scattered position in %, from center), --size (px at 1440 width), --tip (tilt), --float·--delay (float period · delay)
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Body (child) inside the flier that receives the float and bounce — put the image here
options.[data-fx-part=seat]: Seat cells (children): empty cells lined up, their size becomes the seated size
options.hop: Pulse cycle (seconds), default 2.8 — 0 means no pulse
options.on: Threshold for lining up (ratio of section visible), default .5
